THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Ministry of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the LandAcquisition Act (chapter 460), that the land described below is neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotments of land depicted in Advance Tracing No. GA/GFG/2018/513 dated 05.09.2018 prepared by the Surveyor General,(Zone 01 of Cadastral Map No. 810019) situated in the Village ofMaligaspe in the Divisional Secretary's Galle-Four Gravets, in theDistrict of Galle Southern Province. The boundaries of the land is asfollows.

01. Lot ‘A’ - Galagawaliyadda, Assessment No. Not known -Extent: 0.1882 HectareNorth: Canal and Lot No. 19 of Zone 01 Cadastral Map. 810019;East: Lot Nos. 19 and 22 of Zone 01 Cadastral Map 810019; South:Lot No. 22 of Zone 01 Cadastral Map 810019 and Canal;West:Canal.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My No.: 4-3/5/2017/HA/578.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms‘‘Mihikatha Medura’’,No. 1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.27th March 2019.
